title: Farm Animals in English and French

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Listen! Who says moo? A cow!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Let's meet the farm animals, in English, and in French!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And what does a French cow say?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The cow gives us milk. Yum!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And what does a French pig say?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The pig loves to roll in the mud. Splash!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And what does a French sheep say?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The sheep has soft, fluffy wool.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And what does a French duck say?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The duck swims in the pond. Paddle, paddle!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And what does a French hen say?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The hen lays eggs in her nest. Look, an egg!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And what does a French dog say?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The dog helps the farmer. Good dog!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And what does a French cat say?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The cat naps in the warm hay. Shh!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And what does a French mouse say?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The little mouse lives in the barn. Hello, little mouse!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now, let's say them all in French!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: French animal sounds! Who is it?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The cat! Le chat! I got it!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How do you say dog, in French?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
